title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Research task completed successfully. Analysis of beverage cooling data using Newton's Law of Cooling yielded: (1) Ambient temperature ~18-25°C, (2) Cooling rate constant k=0.0082-0.0116 min⁻¹, (3) Excellent model fit (R²=0.9794). Two temperature anomalies were detected and handled via segment analysis. All deliverables complete: code/analyze_beverage_cooling.py, outputs/*.csv, report/report.md, and report/images/*.png.
